violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Roast beef, roast beef in ALTOSHAAM at 82, 83 F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM discarded Roast beef

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Observed commercially cooked potatoes thawing in a broken (non-operational) refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CFM relocated commercially cooked potatoes to walk in refrigerator.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the wall near the back door.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. will ensure that the area near the traps will be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized to remove any signs of mouse droppings. All traps will be checked, cleaned, and repositioned to improve effectiveness. The CFM will implement a daily monitoring and cleaning schedule to maintain sanitation standards. A licensed pest control service will be contacted to assess the situation and apply appropriate rodent control measures. Additionally, the CFM will inspect the facility for potential rodent entry points and ensure they are properly sealed.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling and walls is not maintained in good repair. Observed multiple structural deficiencies throughout the facility, including gaps in the walls near the exterior back door that could allow pest entry, open gaps in the ceiling where cable lines are installed, several broken or missing coved base tiles, and various holes and partially sealed wall penetrations in multiple areas. These conditions compromise the facility’s ability to exclude pests
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. The Certified Food Manager (CFM) will ensure that all gaps in the walls and ceilings are properly sealed using approved pest-proof materials and will work with licensed pest control services to monitor and prevent pest entry.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at back kitchen is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Observed hot water at 68F
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.
